cards.name: Roborock Saros 10R
cards.buy_if: you want the robot that gets stuck least, fits under the most furniture and has the best app.
cards.skip_if: you mostly need serious mopping (get the Narwal Flow 2), or you can only find it at list price.
cards.owners: Owners praise how rarely it needs rescuing. The top complaint is the dock's auto-empty port clogging in multi-pet homes — check it monthly.

cards.name: Dreame L50 Ultra
cards.buy_if: you want last year's flagship — legs that climb thresholds, a hot-water dock — for half its launch price.
cards.skip_if: your furniture sits lower than 3.8 inches, or you want the newest obstacle avoidance.
cards.owners: Owners love the features for the money. Complaints: the tall turret, and a mop-pad smell if the dock isn't cleaned.

cards.name: Narwal Flow 2
cards.buy_if: your floors are mostly hard and you want them visibly cleaner than a spinning-pad robot leaves them.
cards.skip_if: you have a lot of carpet, or a tight budget.
cards.owners: Owners say the floors look mopped, not wiped. Complaints are about the app and a very large dock.

cards.name: eufy Omni S2
cards.buy_if: you have shedding pets, work from home, or hate hair wrapped around the brush.
cards.skip_if: mopping is your main job — the roller-mop robots do it better.
cards.owners: Owners praise the quiet and the tangle-free brush. Complaints mention the price and eufy's app.

cards.name: Dreame X50 Ultra
cards.buy_if: you have thick rugs, door sills or a split-level home.
cards.skip_if: your home is flat and simple — you'd be paying for legs you never use.
cards.owners: Owners are amazed by the climbing. Complaints: it still gets stuck on some thresholds, and the dock is huge.

cards.name: Ecovacs Deebot X9S Pro Omni
cards.price: $1,000–$1,100 (X9 Pro); the X9S is the 2026 refresh
cards.buy_if: you want roller mopping and strong vacuuming in one robot without Narwal's price.
cards.skip_if: you want the best app, or the flattest robot for low furniture.
cards.owners: Owners like the mop results. The complaint is the app, and a noisy dock cycle.
cards.video_title: Ecovacs Deebot X9 Pro Omni review

cards.name: Ecovacs Deebot X11 OmniCyclone
cards.chip: No dust bags · roller mop · 19,500 Pa
cards.buy_if: you never want to buy a dust bag again.
cards.skip_if: you have allergies — emptying a bagless bin is dustier than dropping a bag.
cards.owners: Owners love skipping bags. Complaints: emptying the cyclone bin, and the dock's size.

cards.name: Roborock Saros 20
cards.chip: Remote camera view · many maps · 3.14 in
cards.buy_if: you have a big multi-room home and want the newest Roborock, with a camera you can drive from your phone.
cards.skip_if: the Saros 10R does 95% of this for $400 less.
cards.owners: Too new for a long review history. Early owners praise the navigation and question the price.

cards.name: Roborock Qrevo Curv 2 Flow
cards.buy_if: you want a self-cleaning roller mop and an everything-dock without flagship money.
cards.skip_if: you need the flattest robot or perfect obstacle avoidance.
cards.owners: Owners call it the sweet spot. Complaint: the roller needs an occasional hand-clean.

cards.name: iRobot Roomba Max 705 Vac
cards.badge: Best for long hair & no camera
cards.buy_if: long hair wraps every brush you own, or you don't want a camera roaming the house.
cards.skip_if: you want mopping — this one only vacuums.
cards.owners: Owners praise the tangle-free rubber rollers. Worries centre on iRobot's future after its bankruptcy.

cards.name: Shark PowerDetect Self-Empty
cards.buy_if: your home is mostly carpet and you want a self-empty base with no bags to buy.
cards.skip_if: you want mopping or the fanciest app.
cards.owners: Owners praise carpet pickup for the money. Complaints: the app, and edge cleaning.

cards.name: Roborock Q7 M5+
cards.buy_if: you want real maps and a self-empty dock for about $300.
cards.skip_if: you need obstacle avoidance for cables, socks and pet accidents.
cards.owners: Owners say it simply does the job. Complaint: it eats cables and socks.

cards.name: Dreame D10 Plus Gen 2
cards.buy_if: you want the cheapest robot that empties itself.
cards.skip_if: you have heavy shedders or thick carpet.
cards.owners: Owners love the 90-day bag. Complaints: weak on thick carpet, basic mopping.

cards.name: eufy 11S MAX
cards.chip: 2.85 in · no app · it just works
cards.buy_if: you want daily crumb patrol on hard floors for the price of a nice dinner.
cards.skip_if: you want maps, an app or a dock.
cards.owners: Thousands of owners say it just works. Complaint: random paths, and it bumps furniture.
